title: 月度经营汇总表
learningObjective: 独立构建跨业务月报并下钻门店，区分经营贡献与净利润，正确计算加权指标及滚动费用率。
concept: 每月一行。销售按订单日期、费用按分录日期、人工按员工月份、采购按订单日期、广告按活动月份独立聚合。经营贡献=毛利−费用−人工；广告与采购承诺单列，不重复扣减。无业务月份保留，确认数据完整后才补零。
syntax: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(f.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(h.labor,0) labor_cents,COALESCE(a.spend,0) advertising_cents,COALESCE(p.procurement,0) committed_purchase_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0)-COALESCE(f.expense,0)-COALESCE(h.labor,0) operating_contribution_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key ORDER BY m.month_key

executionSteps: 计算经营贡献并核对异常
useCase: 管理层需要2025年每月全渠道经营概览，将净销售、毛利、费用、人工、广告和采购承诺汇总到同一报表，并在异常月份下钻门店，区分利润、费用压力与采购资金承诺。
comparison: 经营贡献为题设毛利扣费用与人工；门店直接贡献只扣直接归属费用；采购承诺是订购金额，不等于付款或期间费用。

commonError.example: 将原始明细直接相连；重复扣广告或人工；把采购承诺当费用；平均月费用率。
commonError.correction: 按月预聚合，核对费用范围，用总分子除总分母；窗口计算前保留历史。

notes: 原主查询及 BP49.json 保留。独立示例仅在 SQLite 验证；递归日期生成使用 SQLite 专有表达式。未复验企业完整数据库、原生 MySQL、浏览器。依据现行合并映射整合三个来源，未逐篇复核旧课文。

compatibility.detail: 本版本SQLite及sql.js WASM已实际复验，原生MySQL8.4尚未执行。

mergedFrom.title: 门店综合经营异常看板
门店月度收入与费用偏离

teaching.problem: 管理层需要2025年每月全渠道经营概览，将净销售、毛利、费用、人工、广告和采购承诺汇总到同一报表，并在异常月份下钻门店，区分利润、费用压力与采购资金承诺。
teaching.codeExplanation: m 从日历去重取得12个月；s 按订单日期提取月份，汇总净销售与净销售减净成本的毛利；f 按费用入账月份汇总费用；h 按员工月汇总人工估算成本；p 按采购订单月份汇总承诺金额，而非实际付款或销售成本；a 按活动月份汇总广告支出。每个子查询先归并为一月一行，随后从 m 左连接五组结果，避免销售和费用明细多对多相乘。主查询中 s、f、p 只设起始日期，最终与2025月份轴连接限制输出；真实部署可为各模块增加截止边界以减少扫描，但此补丁不修改主查询。COALESCE 用于已确认无业务的情况，来源缺失需另作完整性核验。最后毛利减费用和人工，广告可能已入费用，不重复扣减；人工同样需确认费用中是否已包含，采购承诺不是当期损益。门店下钻时，毛利率用总毛利除总净额，目标达成率仅使用目标为正门店的实际及目标；退款率以折后扣退款前金额为分母。示例以总体加权基准比较低毛利、低达成及高退款，未知比率需另核查。门店贡献用毛利减直接归属费用；总部及未归属人工仍在口径外。滚动费用率按门店采用三个月费用合计除销售合计，在连续月份轴上用 ROWS 窗口，期初需保留报告前两个月，行数不足或分母为零留空；不得平均月比率。
teaching.resultExplanation: 独立案例1月毛利400，费用150，人工100，经营贡献150；广告50及采购承诺500单列。2月无销售但费用80、人工100，贡献为负180，不能删除该月份。3月毛利300减人工150为150。4月至12月完全无记录，示例已知无业务，全部显示0；实际数据未送达不能视为0。门店示例整体毛利率580÷1700=34.12%，正目标门店达成率1500÷1700=88.24%；门店1达成偏低且退款偏高，门店2毛利率低且直接贡献为负60，门店3目标为0不可算达成率，门店4无销售仍有费用。滚动例1月费用120÷销售1000=12%，不同于各月费率的简单平均；4月窗口净销售为0，结果为空。原企业2025年1月公布贡献2944637−65219277−51797482=−114072122分，不是完整净利润；须核验费用归属及是否重复计入人工，不据此直接认定企业亏损。

checkpoints.name: m
checkpoints.label: 准备完整自然月份轴
checkpoints.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12')
SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.label: 按月汇总销售与毛利
checkpoints.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7))
SELECT * FROM s ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 门店下钻；整体毛利率及正目标门店达成率使用总量比率；对照整体指标筛查低毛利、低达成、高退款。
门店毛利扣直接归属费用形成门店贡献，未分摊总部费用或人工需单独注明。
连续月份上计算三个月总费用除总净销售，保留前两个月历史，窗口不足或零分母留空。

mergeExamples.label: 建立完整月份轴
mergeExamples.explanation: 使用自然月份主轴，保证无业务的月份仍然存在。独立示例使用 SQLite 日期函数生成月份；主查询使用现有日历表。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE calendar_days(month_key) AS (SELECT '2025-01' UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',date(month_key||'-01','+1 month')) FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key<'2025-12'),
v_sales_lines(order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-05',600,360 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01-06',400,240 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03-01',800,500 UNION ALL SELECT '2024-12-01',999,0 UNION ALL SELECT '2026-01-01',999,0),
v_expenses(entry_date,expense_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-03',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01-07',50 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02-03',80),
v_staff_month(month_key,labor_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03',150),
v_po_lines(order_date,ordered_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-04',500 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02-06',200),
marketing_campaigns(month_key,spend_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01',50 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02',20),
m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12') SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY month_key

v_expenses(entry_date,expense_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-03',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01-07',50 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02-03',80),

v_expenses(entry_date,expense_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-03',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01-07',50 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02-03',80),
v_staff_month(month_key,labor_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03',150),

mergeExamples.label: 门店经营异常看板
mergeExamples.explanation: 独立门店月数据；仅正目标门店参与整体达成率；空值不等于正常，需单独复核。以整体加权指标作为示例比较基准，非原课固定阈值。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH store_month(store_id,net,gross,target,refund,pre_refund,direct_expense) AS (SELECT 1,1000,400,1200,100,1100,150 UNION ALL SELECT 2,500,100,400,0,500,160 UNION ALL SELECT 3,200,80,0,0,200,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,0,100,0,0,30),
benchmark AS (SELECT 100.0*SUM(gross)/NULLIF(SUM(net),0) overall_margin,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN net ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target ELSE 0 END),0) overall_attainment,100.0*SUM(refund)/NULLIF(SUM(pre_refund),0) overall_refund FROM store_month),
metrics AS (SELECT *,100.0*gross/NULLIF(net,0) margin,100.0*net/NULLIF(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target END,0) attainment,100.0*refund/NULLIF(pre_refund,0) refund_pct FROM store_month)
SELECT store_id,ROUND(margin,2) margin_pct,ROUND(attainment,2) attainment_pct,ROUND(refund_pct,2) refund_pct,ROUND(overall_margin,2) overall_margin,ROUND(overall_attainment,2) overall_attainment,CASE WHEN margin<overall_margin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END low_margin,CASE WHEN attainment<overall_attainment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END low_attainment,CASE WHEN refund_pct>overall_refund THEN 1 ELSE 0 END high_refund FROM metrics CROSS JOIN benchmark ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC

mergeExamples.label: 门店直接费用与贡献
mergeExamples.explanation: 示例为已归属门店直接费用的月度汇总；未分摊总部费用或另列人工，不能当作净利润。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH store_month(store_id,net,gross,target,refund,pre_refund,direct_expense) AS (SELECT 1,1000,400,1200,100,1100,150 UNION ALL SELECT 2,500,100,400,0,500,160 UNION ALL SELECT 3,200,80,0,0,200,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,0,100,0,0,30),
benchmark AS (SELECT 100.0*SUM(gross)/NULLIF(SUM(net),0) overall_margin,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN net ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target ELSE 0 END),0) overall_attainment,100.0*SUM(refund)/NULLIF(SUM(pre_refund),0) overall_refund FROM store_month),
metrics AS (SELECT *,100.0*gross/NULLIF(net,0) margin,100.0*net/NULLIF(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target END,0) attainment,100.0*refund/NULLIF(pre_refund,0) refund_pct FROM store_month)
 SELECT store_id,net,gross,direct_expense,gross-direct_expense store_contribution FROM store_month ORDER BY net

mergeExamples.label: 跨年滚动三个月费用率
mergeExamples.explanation: 先保留2024年11、12月，再计算窗口，最后筛选报告期。示例各门店已具备连续有效月份；生产数据需先补齐月份并验证覆盖。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH monthly(store_id,month_key,net,expense) AS (SELECT 1,'2024-11',100,10 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2024-12',200,40 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-01',700,70 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',0,20 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-03',0,0 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-04',0,0 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-02',100,20 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-03',100,10),
w AS (SELECT *,SUM(expense) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cnt FROM monthly)
SELECT store_id,month_key,ROUND(100.0*expense/NULLIF(net,0),2) monthly_pct,CASE WHEN cnt=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(n3,0),2) END rolling_pct FROM w WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY month_key DESC, monthly_pct DESC
